placements.why: Establishes the Organization strata category to house team operational procedures, internal workflows, and onboarding processes.
placements.title: Organizational Structure and Operational Practices
placements.frame: How are team roles, operational practices, and internal workflows structured and maintained across the organization?

placements.title: Mandatory Onboarding Checklists Replace Legacy Ad-Hoc Documentation
placements.frame: How are incoming team members operationalized during their initial onboarding period?
placements.why: Captures the operational shift to a formal, required first-week checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) that replaced unmanaged legacy wiki documentation.
